note: All five cases are made up. Each run gets its own throwaway project in the local Plane (setup_case.py) and a small git repository. What happened is read back from Plane, git and the run's steps by check_runs.py; no model grades.

evals.name: Small bug no ticket named
evals.prompt: count_words('a  b') in tally/count.py returns 3 when there are two spaces in a row. It should return 2. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: A Plane ticket is made under the epic Counting before the first edit, moved to started, the fix is committed locally with the ticket's key in the message, a completion comment is posted and the ticket is Done.
expectations: A new ticket exists in the run's Plane project
The new ticket was made before the first edit of a repository file
The new ticket's parent is the ticket named Epic: Counting
A commit was made whose message names the new ticket's key
The new ticket has a comment
The new ticket is in a completed state
count_words('a  b') returns 2 and the tests pass

evals.name: What to work on next
evals.prompt: What should I work on next in this repo?
evals.expected_output: Up to five candidates as linked key plus title, in the order tickets 7, 9, 5, 8, 6, then a question which one to take. Nothing in Plane or in the repository is changed.
expectations: The answer names at most five tickets
The tickets appear in the order 7, 9, 5, 8, 6
No completed or cancelled ticket is offered
The answer ends by asking which one to take
No ticket was created or changed and no commit was made

evals.name: Change that fits no epic
evals.prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the unit tests on every push.
evals.expected_output: No epic fits. The run stops and asks about a new epic, naming the one it proposes, before it creates an epic or edits the repository.
expectations: No new top-level ticket was created
No repository file was changed and no commit was made
The answer asks the user about a new epic and names a proposal

evals.name: Quick lookup
evals.prompt: Which files in this repository use Python's re module?
evals.expected_output: The three files tally/clean.py, tally/tokens.py and tests/test_tokens.py. No ticket, no page, no commit.
expectations: The answer names tally/clean.py, tally/tokens.py and tests/test_tokens.py
No ticket was created or changed
No repository file was changed and no commit was made

evals.name: Bug with a link to another tracker
evals.prompt: Fix the double-space bug that OPS-412 describes (see the README) and record the result.
evals.expected_output: The fix runs the full course in the local Plane. Nothing is sent to the other tracker; the answer says so or offers to draft an update.
expectations: No step of the run tried to write to jira.example.invalid
A new ticket exists in the run's Plane project
A commit was made whose message names the new ticket's key
The new ticket has a comment
The new ticket is in a completed state
The answer says that the other tracker was not updated
